<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def hs(fr):
    nodes=fr.segmentation['nodes'];d={}
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color'] in('b','S') and n['pixels']==8:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']];cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            if 17<=min(rs)<=23: d[n['color']]=(min(cs),max(cs),min(rs),max(rs))
    return d
def timer(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n');w=0
    for r in range(64):
        if a[r][62]=='W': w+=1
    return w
print("start",hs(current_frame),"timerW=",timer(current_frame))
r=action(['DOWN'],intent='explore')
res=last_action_result
print("after DOWN:",hs(current_frame),"| done=",res.get('done'),"lvl=",res.get('level_completed'),"noimp=",res.get('no_impact'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
